items.title: Billie Pierce, De De Pierce, Israel Gorman, Joseph "Kid Twat" Butler Interview, 1963-11-20
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] The Onward band, but that was Emmanuel Perez.

ctx.x: The Excelsior. You never played with the Onward?
The Onward band, but that was Emmanuel Perez.
Oh, I see. Let's see, what other things can I ask you about? I think we just about got enough for a little write-up on the sleeve, so we can catch it now. Do you want to tell me something?
